versions.changelog:
tencentcloud-sms-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Tencent Cloud SMS Skill.
- Enables SMS sending (verification codes, notifications, marketing), including single and bulk sending.
- Supports signature and template management: query, apply, and track review status.
- Provides SMS package usage statistics and delivery/receipt tracking by phone number.
- Designed with strict security and user interaction guidelines.
- Covers domestic and international/HK/Macau/Taiwan SMS scenarios via Tencent Cloud SMS API.
